content.raw:
Just over the bridge from Tampa

Jet Ski Rentals Tampa Bay

Skip the river traffic and no-wake zones. Our St. Petersburg launch puts Tampa Bay riders on open Gulf water, with Egmont Key, Shell Key and dolphins in range.

Check Availability Call (813) 538-4802

Worth the drive

Why Tampa riders come to St. Pete

We're an easy drive from Tampa over the Howard Frankland or Gandy Bridge. The short trip buys you a dramatically better day on the water.

Real Gulf access, not just bay cruising.

No river traffic and far fewer no-wake zones.

Egmont Key is within reach on longer rides.

Brand-new Yamaha WaveRunners with Bluetooth audio, not base models.

Where you'll ride

The best riding in Tampa Bay

Egmont Key

Clear water, historic lighthouse views and dolphin sightings at the mouth of the bay.

Shell Key

An undeveloped island perfect for sandbar stops, shelling and photos.

Open Gulf water

Wide-open throttle, smooth riding and scenery you won't get on the river.

Check Availability Compare Tours

Who we serve

Riders from all over the bay

We regularly welcome riders from Tampa, South Tampa, Clearwater, Brandon, Riverview, Wesley Chapel, Largo and St. Pete Beach. If you're anywhere in Tampa Bay, this is your launch.

Before you drive over

Renters must be 18+ with a valid photo ID. Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 needs a Florida boater safety card, which you can get online in minutes. Arrive 30 minutes early.

Get your boater card

Tampa Bay's best ride is in St. Pete.

5.0 on Google with 600+ reviews. Book online or give us a call.

Check Availability Call (813) 538-4802
